bankStatements.title: Bank statements
bankStatements.description: Import bank statement files using an external bank parser, then review transactions before importing.
bankStatements.unavailableDescription: Could not load supported banks. Try again later.
bankStatements.notConfiguredDescription: An administrator needs to configure the external bank parser before you can import statements.
bankStatements.leaveDescription: Your uploaded files and review choices will be lost. An import already started will continue in the background.
bankStatements.privacyNotice: Files are sent to the external bank parser configured by your administrator. Only upload statements you want that service to process. Unfinished reviews are not saved when you leave this page.
bankStatements.chooseFiles: Choose statement files or drag them here
bankStatements.fileLimits: Choose up to 20 non-empty files, no larger than 10 MiB each.
bankStatements.failedFilesHint: Retry failed files or exclude them before continuing to review.
bankStatements.selectRequired: Select a bank and a target account for this file.
bankStatements.unsupportedFormat: This file format is not supported by the selected bank parser.
bankStatements.currencyMismatch: Statement currencies must match the target account currency. Choose another account or file.
bankStatements.transactionLimit: A batch can contain no more than 50,000 transactions. Exclude some files and try again.
bankStatements.parseFailed: Could not read this statement. Check the selected bank and file, then try again or exclude it.
bankStatements.reviewFailed: Could not review these statements. Try again.
bankStatements.executeFailed: Could not confirm the import. Try again to check or start the same import.
bankStatements.skipHint: Potential duplicates are skipped by default. Clear a checkbox to import a row anyway. Transactions covered by bank sync cannot be selected for import.

matchTypes.batch: Matches another file in this batch

bankStatements.confirmDescription: Transactions to import: {count}. The import runs in the background. If a file fails, transactions saved from other files will be kept.
bankStatements.jobContinues: You can leave this page. An import already started continues in the background; imported transactions appear in Import history.
bankStatements.fileFailed: This file could not be imported. Transactions saved from other files were kept.
